# Project brief

Owner: [human]. Event/deadline/time zone: [actual details]. Last reviewed: [date].

User and setting: name one person and the moment they need help. Problem: describe the current behavior and its cost. Evidence: link interviews, observations or data, and label assumptions. Core workflow: input → transformation → useful result. Distinctive capability: one technical behavior judges can observe. Rubric: quote only the relevant criteria and map them to demonstrable outcomes.

Constraints: team/time, API budget, privacy, hosting, eligibility and data access. Non-goals: scope explicitly excluded. Success: observable user outcome, acceptable latency/failure behavior and evidence needed. Example: “A community coordinator uploads a short project brief, verifies extracted deadlines against source passages, edits one field and downloads a report in under two minutes.” Treat timing as a target until measured.
